name: mf_fno_lora
description: Fidelity-conditioned LoRA-adapted MF-FNO. Same FiLM-on-X FNO backbone (common.backbone) and LF-pretrain -> HF-finetune transfer schedule as the benchmark winner mf_fno_transfer_film, but HF adaptation is parameter-efficient: after full-backbone LF pretraining the backbone is FROZEN and zero-init low-rank adapters (LoRA, Hu 2022; rank r=4) are injected into every 1x1 Conv2d (block w, lift, proj) and optionally the FiLM-MLP Linears; HF-finetuning trains ONLY the adapters. Zero-init B makes the pre-finetune model identical to the LF-pretrained model (exact reduction), so finetune-vs-frozen HF nRMSE isolates the LF->HF gap. The complex spectral kernels are left un-adapted by design. extra reports adapter_params, adapter_norm (LF->HF-gap proxy), and pct_params_trained.
